name: When during a kitchen remodel should I plan my appliance layout?

mainEntity.name: When during a kitchen remodel should I plan my appliance layout?

acceptedAnswer.text: The best stage to plan your kitchen appliance layout is during early design, before ordering custom cabinets or roughing in mechanical lines. Major appliances dictate cabinet clearances, counter depths, framing adjustments, and where electrical and plumbing hookups must go. If you wait until after cabinets are built or framing is finished, modifying water supply lines or 240-volt circuits requires opening drywall and rework, which increases expenses and delays progress. Planning early lets your contractor coordinate carpentry, framing, and specialty trade rough-ins around exact appliance specification sheets.
acceptedAnswer.description: Plan your appliance layout during initial design, well before ordering cabinets or running rough-in electrical and plumbing lines to prevent expensive framing and utility changes.
